connector.name: Cobra · Facturación SRI Ecuador
connector.registryDescription: Emite facturas, notas y retenciones del SRI de Ecuador con lenguaje natural.
connector.summary: Hosted at facturacobra.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.facturacobra, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer + tu llave de API de Cobra (mfact_...), desde Config > Desarrolladores.
